rules: One question asks one observable point
Capability/category name is separate display context, not mechanically prepended to every question
Keep detailed diagnostic specificity mainly in answer options
B/Q2 asks recent or quantified evidence with matching tense
C/Q3 asks independent corroboration in plain language
D/Q4 resolves conflicting information neutrally without presupposing a contradiction
Never alter the frozen semantic/scoring contract during humanization

priority_replacements.батлагдах / баталж болох: Prefer a direct observable phrase such as 'бүртгэлээс харагддаг уу?' or 'өөр эх сурвалжаар шалгаж болдог уу?' where semantically valid
priority_replacements.зөрүү байвал: Use neutral conflict-resolution wording without assuming a contradiction
priority_replacements.тулгахад / тулгалт: Prefer 'хооронд нь харьцуулахад' where the same fact is preserved
priority_replacements.эх өгөгдөл: Prefer 'анхны бүртгэл' or 'эх мэдээлэл' depending on construct
priority_replacements.тайлант хугацаа: Use the actual reference period in plain language
priority_replacements.нэг утгаар тогтоох: Prefer 'тодорхой болгож болох уу?' where appropriate
